summary.text: Lacey Hull is a Republican state representative who has represented Texas House District 138 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she chairs the Texas House Committee on Human Services.

paragraphs.text: Lacey Hull was born in Houston, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston in 2008.
Hull succeeded Dwayne Bohac in representing District 138 and assumed office on January 12, 2021.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Human Services, Insurance, and Local & Consent Calendars committees.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she also serves on the State Affairs Committee and its Telecommunications and Broadband subcommittee.
She said in the survey that she is particularly passionate about protecting children, strengthening families, improving access to healthcare and serving Texans with disabilities.
She defeated Stephanie Morales in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary; Tyler Smith is the Democratic candidate in 2026.
